risk_categories.name: Prohibited practice
risk_categories.definition: AI practices banned under Article 5 (e.g. social scoring, certain biometric categorisation, manipulative techniques).

risk_categories.name: High-risk (Annex III use case)
risk_categories.definition: Stand-alone AI whose use case matches one of the eight Annex III domains AND performs a listed function (Article 6(2)). Full high-risk obligation set.

risk_categories.name: High-risk (Annex I regulated product)
risk_categories.definition: AI that is a safety component of, or is, a product covered by EU harmonisation legislation in Annex I (Article 6(1)).

risk_categories.name: GPAI model
risk_categories.definition: General-purpose AI model. Provider transparency + documentation + copyright duties.

risk_categories.name: GPAI model with systemic risk
risk_categories.definition: GPAI model meeting systemic-risk thresholds; additional evaluation, risk-mitigation, incident-reporting and cybersecurity duties.

risk_categories.name: Limited-risk / transparency
risk_categories.definition: Systems triggering Article 50 transparency duties regardless of high-risk status (chatbots, synthetic content, deepfakes, emotion recognition).

risk_categories.name: Minimal risk
risk_categories.definition: Everything else; no mandatory obligations under the Act (voluntary codes only).
